```{r, echo=FALSE, fig.height=12}
library(tidyverse)
library(pegas)

gdatw <- 
  readRDS("../admixture/gdatw.RDS")

gdatw$pop <- 
  gsub(pattern="River", replacement="R", gdatw$pop) |> 
  gsub(pattern="Creek", replacement="C") |> 
  gsub(pattern="Hatchery", replacement="H") |> 
  gsub(pattern="Chinook_", replacement="") |> 
  gsub(pattern="Buckley_Trap_", replacement="") |> 
  gsub(pattern="at_", replacement="_") |> 
  gsub(pattern="unclipped", replacement="Fall") |>
  gsub(pattern="_PBT", replacement="Fall") |>
  gsub(pattern="WDFW_FH", replacement="Fall") |>
  gsub(pattern="Spring_Fall_06KK", replacement="Spring_06KK_Baseline") |>
  gsub(pattern="R_24ND", replacement="R_Spring_24ND_Baseline") |>
  gsub(pattern="R_25NI", replacement="R_Spring_25NI_Baseline") |>
  gsub(pattern="fall", replacement="Fall") |>
  gsub(pattern="08HZ", replacement="08HZ_Baseline") |>
  gsub(pattern="98HB", replacement="98HB_Baseline") |>
  gsub(pattern="10JX", replacement="10JX_Baseline") |>
  gsub(pattern="12IP", replacement="12IP_Baseline") |>
  gsub(pattern="__", replacement="_")

gdatw_loci <- 
  reduce(
    names(gdatw) |> 
      grep("_a[12]$", x=_, value=TRUE) |> 
      sub("_a[12]$", "", x=_) |> 
      unique(),
    \(df, prefix){
      unite(
        df,
        col=!!prefix,
        matches(paste0("^", prefix, "_a[12]$")),
        sep="/",
        na.rm=TRUE)},
    .init=gdatw) |>
  mutate(across(7:250, ~na_if(., "")), across(.cols=c(7:250), ~factor(.))) |>
  select(-2:-6) |>
  rename(population=pop)

White_R_NOR <- 
  filter(gdatw_loci, !grepl(pattern="Baseline", population)) |>
  mutate(code=str_extract(string=population, pattern="\\w{4}$")) |>
  relocate(code, .before=1)

Baseline_FALL <- 
  filter(gdatw_loci, grepl(pattern="Baseline", population)) |>
  filter(!grepl(pattern="Spring", population)) |>
  mutate(code=str_extract(string=population, pattern="\\d{2}\\w{2}")) |>
  relocate(code, .before=1)


nor_fall <- 
  function(nor.code, fall.code, n){
    bind_rows(
      NOR=filter(White_R_NOR, code %in% nor.code), 
      FALL=filter(Baseline_FALL, code %in% fall.code), 
      .id="group") |>
      slice_sample(n=n, by=group, replace=FALSE) |>
      select(-group, -code) |>
      mutate(population=factor(population)) |>
      as.loci()}

FST <- 
  function(adf){
    require(pegas)
    x <- Fst(adf)[, 2] |> as.double()
    bar <- mean(x, na.rm=TRUE)
    return(list(x=x, bar=bar))}

permute2samplet <- 
  function(x, n_loci){
    n <- n_loci*2
    idx_b <- sample(1:n, n_loci)
    idx_a <- setdiff(1:n, idx_b)
    mean_diff <- mean(x[idx_b], na.rm=TRUE) - mean(x[idx_a], na.rm=TRUE)
    return(mean_diff)}


boot1mean <- 
  function(x){
    xx <- sample(x, replace=TRUE)
    mean_xx <- mean(xx, na.rm=TRUE)
    return(mean_xx)}

table(Baseline_FALL$population)

d1 <- 
  nor_fall(nor.code="21LC", fall.code="98HB", n=39)

# FST(d1)$x |> hist(breaks=30)

FSTy25 <- FST(d5)$x

bootFSTy21 <- rep(NA, 1000)
bootFSTy22 <- rep(NA, 1000)
bootFSTy23 <- rep(NA, 1000)
bootFSTy24 <- rep(NA, 1000)
bootFSTy25 <- rep(NA, 1000)
bootFSTy26 <- rep(NA, 1000)



for(i in 1:1000){bootFSTy21[i] <- boot1mean(FSTy21)}
for(i in 1:1000){bootFSTy22[i] <- boot1mean(FSTy22)}
for(i in 1:1000){bootFSTy23[i] <- boot1mean(FSTy23)}
for(i in 1:1000){bootFSTy24[i] <- boot1mean(FSTy24)}
for(i in 1:1000){bootFSTy25[i] <- boot1mean(FSTy25)}
for(i in 1:1000){bootFSTy26[i] <- boot1mean(FSTy26)}


bootplot <- 
  function(bs, fst, ...){
    hist(bs, breaks=30, font.main=1, xlab=expression(italic(F)[ST]), ...=...)
    abline(v=quantile(bs, probs=c(0.025, 0.975)), col="blue", lwd=2, lty=2)
    abline(v=mean(fst, na.rm=TRUE), col="blue", lwd=2)}


par(mfrow=c(6, 1))
bootplot(bs=bootFSTy21, fst=FSTy21, xlim=c(0.01, 0.04), main="2021")
bootplot(bs=bootFSTy22, fst=FSTy22, xlim=c(0.01, 0.04), main="2022")
bootplot(bs=bootFSTy23, fst=FSTy23, xlim=c(0.01, 0.04), main="2023")
bootplot(bs=bootFSTy24, fst=FSTy24, xlim=c(0.01, 0.04), main="2024")
bootplot(bs=bootFSTy25, fst=FSTy25, xlim=c(0.01, 0.04), main="2025")
bootplot(bs=bootFSTy26, fst=FSTy26, xlim=c(0.01, 0.04), main="2026")
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, fig.height=8}

# 2021-2022
deltaFSTy21y22 <- FST(d8)$bar - FST(d7)$bar

# 2022-2023
deltaFSTy22y23 <- FST(d9)$bar - FST(d8)$bar

# 2023-2024
deltaFSTy23y24 <- FST(d10)$bar - FST(d9)$bar

# 2024-2025
deltaFSTy24y25 <- FST(d5)$bar - FST(d10)$bar

# 2025-2026
deltaFSTy25y26 <- FST(d6)$bar - FST(d5)$bar


FSTy21y22 <- c(FST(d7)$x, FST(d8)$x)
FSTy22y23 <- c(FST(d8)$x, FST(d9)$x)
FSTy23y24 <- c(FST(d9)$x, FST(d10)$x)
FSTy24y25 <- c(FST(d10)$x, FST(d5)$x)
FSTy25y26 <- c(FST(d5)$x, FST(d6)$x)


FSTy21y22perm <- rep(NA, 1000)
FSTy22y23perm <- rep(NA, 1000)
FSTy23y24perm <- rep(NA, 1000)
FSTy24y25perm <- rep(NA, 1000)
FSTy25y26perm <- rep(NA, 1000)


for(i in 1:1000){FSTy21y22perm[i] <- permute2samplet(x=FSTy21y22, n_loci=243)}
for(i in 1:1000){FSTy22y23perm[i] <- permute2samplet(x=FSTy22y23, n_loci=243)}
for(i in 1:1000){FSTy23y24perm[i] <- permute2samplet(x=FSTy23y24, n_loci=243)}
for(i in 1:1000){FSTy24y25perm[i] <- permute2samplet(x=FSTy24y25, n_loci=243)}
for(i in 1:1000){FSTy25y26perm[i] <- permute2samplet(x=FSTy25y26, n_loci=243)}


permplot <- 
  function(perm, deltaFST, note="", ...){
    pval <- mean(abs(c(perm, deltaFST)) >= abs(deltaFST)) |> round(digits=5)
    hist(perm, breaks=30, main=paste(note, "p-value:", pval), font.main=1, xlab=expression(Null~Distribution~of~Delta~italic(F)[ST]), , ...=...)
    abline(v=deltaFST, col="red", lwd=2)}


par(mfrow=c(5, 1))
permplot(perm=FSTy21y22perm, deltaFST=deltaFSTy21y22, xlim=c(-0.015, 0.015), note="2021-2022")
permplot(perm=FSTy22y23perm, deltaFST=deltaFSTy22y23, xlim=c(-0.015, 0.015), note="2022-2023")
permplot(perm=FSTy23y24perm, deltaFST=deltaFSTy23y24, xlim=c(-0.015, 0.015), note="2023-2024")
permplot(perm=FSTy24y25perm, deltaFST=deltaFSTy24y25, xlim=c(-0.015, 0.015), note="2024-2025")
permplot(perm=FSTy25y26perm, deltaFST=deltaFSTy25y26, xlim=c(-0.015, 0.015), note="2025-2026")
```
